invariants.name: head_scope_resolves_the_subtree_once
invariants.note: An inherited paint change at the head re-resolves its subtree once. More than one visit per node would mean the parent chain is walked per descendant.

invariants.name: head_scope_does_not_lay_out
invariants.note: An inherited colour is not a layout input.

notes: Issue #101 §4 subtree style mutation at the head of a 10k tree. This is what a ThemeScope patch costs before ThemeScope exists (Issue #100 §5).
